messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "continue to take tablets even if you feel well"
set: ["continue to take tablets even if you feel well", "keep taking even if you feel well", "keep using even if you feel well", "do this even if you feel well", "continue using even if feeling well", "keep using carvedilol even if you feel well", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "do this even if you are feeling well", "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure", "continue even if no immediate improvement", "get medical help right away if you don't feel well", "especially if you take other drugs as well", "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine", "get medical advice even if the person seems well"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "keep taking even if you feel well",
    "keep using even if you feel well",
    "do this even if you feel well",
    "continue using even if feeling well",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well",
    "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "do this even if you are feeling well",
    "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure",
    "continue even if no immediate improvement",
    "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine"
  ],
  "alias": "continue to take tablets even if you feel well"
}
